g.aria-label: Indexer scoring → masks → Top-k integer positions / Qindex[32,128] × Kindexᵀ[128,S] → [32,S]; ReLU × head weights → sum heads → [S]. / Causal mask: only completed groups are visible. Reuse skips scoring. / Reindex changes selected positions; it does not regenerate the KV vectors.

Candidate blocks: 8 positions/block, ≤2048 blocks, newest pinned. Source scores first, masks later.
Decoder · every layer in execution order
BLUE: four-stream state + delayed pre_mix. GOLD: shared KV. PURPLE: indices. Every layer builds its own Q + Local KV.

After Layer 39: final mHC collapse → RMSNorm → vocabulary Head. DSpark runs only through a separate forward_spec() call.
Full replaces the active shared reference; earlier source caches remain allocated. Reindex replaces position IDs, not KV.
Owner labels describe completed compression groups. See the source note for the local incomplete-group Index Key caveat.

Prefill: start_pos=0 only seeds the three private draft caches; forward_spec returns None.
generate.py runs normal autoregressive decode; draft / verify / accept-reject serving is not implemented there.
Draft-specific FLOPs are not substituted with backbone totals. Existing calculation links retain their original scope.
